function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapDecoder
function.description: This function returns the IcoDecoder instance that contains the given IWICBitmapDecoder interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IWICBitmapDecoder interface contained within an IcoDecoder instance.

function.return_type: IcoDecoder *: Pointer to the IcoDecoder instance that contains the given IWICBitmapDecoder interface.

function.name: impl_from_IWICBitmapFrameDecode
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an IcoFrameDecode structure that contains the given IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface

function.return_type: IcoFrameDecode *: Pointer to IcoFrameDecode structure containing the given IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface pointer

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query the interface of a bitmap frame decode object. It checks if the provided interface ID matches with any of the known interface IDs (IUnknown, IWICBitmapSource, IWICBitmapFrameDecode). If it matches, the function returns a pointer to the interface. If not, it returns a NULL pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap frame decode object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This is the interface ID that is being queried.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer. It is used to return the interface pointer if the queried interface ID matches with any of the known interface IDs.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the ppv parameter is NULL, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the queried interface ID does not match with any of the known interface IDs, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IcoFrameDecode object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface of the IcoFrameDecode object.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_Release
function.description: This function releases the IcoFrameDecode object and decreases its reference count. If the reference count is 0, it frees the memory allocated for the object and its bits.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IcoFrameDecode object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the updated reference count of the IcoFrameDecode object after it has been decremented.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetSize
function.description: This function retrieves the width and height of an ICO frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for decoding bitmap frames.

parameters.name: puiWidth
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the width of the ICO frame.

parameters.name: puiHeight
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the height of the ICO frame.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetPixelFormat
function.description: This function copies the value of GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppBGRA into the memory location pointed to by pPixelFormat and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface

parameters.name: pPixelFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICPixelFormatGUID structure that receives the pixel format of the bitmap frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetResolution
function.description: This function retrieves the resolution of an ICO frame.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the ICO frame to decode.

parameters.name: pDpiX
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the horizontal resolution.

parameters.name: pDpiY
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the vertical resolution.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_CopyPalette
function.description: This function is used to copy the palette but it always returns an error indicating that the palette is unavailable.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to a bitmap frame decoder.

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and warning conditions. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE indicating that the palette is unavailable.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_CopyPixels
function.description: This function is used to copy pixels from a source to a destination buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the bitmap frame decode object

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a rectangle structure that specifies the portion of the source bitmap to copy

parameters.name: cbStride
parameters.description: Specifies the stride, or pitch, of the destination bitmap

parameters.name: cbBufferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the buffer to receive the bitmap data

parameters.name: pbBuffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer to receive the bitmap data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetMetadataQueryReader
function.description: This function is used to get the metadata query reader from an ICO frame decode interface. However, this operation is currently unsupported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an ICO frame decode interface.

parameters.name: ppIMetadataQueryReader
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a metadata query reader interface. The function would normally fill this with the requested interface, but currently it is unsupported.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and warning conditions. The function returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION, indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetColorContexts
function.description: This function is used to get color contexts of an ICO frame. However, it is currently unsupported and always returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface pointer to the bitmap frame to decode.

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: The count of color contexts to get.

parameters.name: ppIColorContexts
parameters.description: A pointer to the array of color contexts to get.

parameters.name: pcActualCount
parameters.description: A pointer to the actual count of color contexts retrieved.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: IcoFrameDecode_GetThumbnail
function.description: This function is used to get the thumbnail from a given interface and store it in a provided bitmap source pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the thumbnail is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: ppIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is the pointer to the bitmap source where the retrieved thumbnail will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: pixel_set_trans
function.description: This function sets the transparency of a pixel.

parameters.name: pixel
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the pixel to be set.

parameters.name: transparent
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the pixel should be transparent or not.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: ReadIcoDib
function.description: This function reads a bitmap image from an input stream and decodes it into a frame. It handles different pixel formats and manages memory for the decoded image. It also handles transparency and alpha channels.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream from which the bitmap image is read.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the structure where the decoded frame will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function execution. If the function executes successfully, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: ReadIcoPng
function.description: This function reads an ICO PNG image from a stream, decodes it, and stores the result in an IcoFrameDecode structure.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: The input stream from which the ICO PNG image is read.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: The structure in which the decoded image data is stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IcoDecoder_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface; otherwise, it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored if the requested interface is supported

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if it is not, and E_INVALIDARG if ppv is NULL

function.name: IcoDecoder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IcoDecoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.name: IcoDecoder_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources used by the IcoDecoder object. It decreases the reference count of the object, and if the reference count becomes zero, it deletes the critical section, releases the stream if it exists, and frees the memory allocated to the object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface of the IcoDecoder object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the IcoDecoder object after it has been decremented.

function.name: IcoDecoder_QueryCapability
function.description: This function queries the capability of an ICO decoder. It initializes the decoder and sets its capability to decode all images.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of the IWICBitmapDecoder interface.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the stream to be decoded.

parameters.name: capability
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD to receive the decoder's capabilities.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the function call. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IcoDecoder_Initialize
function.description: This function initializes an ICO decoder. It reads the header of the ICO file, checks its validity, and prepares the decoder for further operations.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that provides methods for decoding an image.

parameters.name: pIStream
parameters.description: Pointer to a stream interface that represents the ICO file to be decoded.

parameters.name: cacheOptions
parameters.description: Options for caching the decoded image.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetContainerFormat
function.description: This function copies the GUID of the ICO container format to the provided GUID pointer and returns a success code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: pguidContainerFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to a GUID variable where the ICO container format GUID will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetDecoderInfo
function.description: This function retrieves decoder information for an ICO (icon) file.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for a bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: ppIDecoderInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the decoder information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the get_decoder_info function.

function.name: IcoDecoder_CopyPalette
function.description: This function is used to copy the palette from a bitmap decoder interface to a palette interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the bitmap decoder interface from which the palette is to be copied.

parameters.name: pIPalette
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the palette interface where the palette is to be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. In this function, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE indicating that the palette is unavailable.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetMetadataQueryReader
function.description: This function is used to get the metadata query reader from an ICO decoder. However, it currently returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: ppIMetadataQueryReader
parameters.description: Double pointer to an instance of IWICMetadataQueryReader interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetPreview
function.description: This function is used to get a preview of an ICO decoder. However, it currently returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: ppIBitmapSource
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to a bitmap source.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating that the operation is not supported.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetColorContexts
function.description: This function is used to get the color contexts of an ICO decoder. However, it currently returns an unsupported operation error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface of a bitmap decoder

parameters.name: cCount
parameters.description: The count of color contexts to get

parameters.name: ppIColorContexts
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer of color contexts to get

parameters.name: pcActualCount
parameters.description: Pointer to the actual count of color contexts obtained

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_UNSUPPORTEDOPERATION indicating the operation is not supported.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetThumbnail
function.description: This function is used to get the thumbnail of an ICO decoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface pointer to the bitmap decoder.

parameters.name: ppIThumbnail
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to the bitmap source for the thumbnail.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_CODECNOTHUMBNAIL indicating that the codec does not support thumbnail generation.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetFrameCount
function.description: This function retrieves the frame count of an ICO decoder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IWICBitmapDecoder interface of the ICO decoder object.

parameters.name: pCount
parameters.description: Pointer to a UINT variable that receives the frame count.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: IcoDecoder_GetFrame
function.description: This function decodes a frame from an ICO file. It reads the icon entry, creates a stream object for the icon, reads the bitmapinfo size or magic number, and forwards to the appropriate decoding function based on the magic number. If any step fails, it cleans up and returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IWICBitmapDecoder interface

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the frame to decode

parameters.name: ppIBitmapFrame
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IWICBitmapFrameDecode interface, which will be filled with the decoded frame

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, and an error code on failure

function.name: IcoDecoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of IcoDecoder, initializes it and assigns it to the provided pointer, and then queries and releases an interface for the IcoDecoder instance.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: The interface identifier to be queried.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the pointer to the created IcoDecoder instance will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.
